transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess I came in because my eating just went completely off the rails. I usually pay attention to that stuff, but recently I just stopped caring about my food tracking altogether. I've been skipping real meals for days at a time, basically just living on coffee and protein bars. Honestly, my clothes started hanging loose on me before I even really noticed it was happening.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy recently?

Yeah, I have. Recently, a project sponsor at work questioned my judgment, and after that... it was like the bottom just dropped out. I just sat in my apartment feeling completely hollow and ashamed. I was even crying over regular work emails that I normally would have handled without a second thought. So, yes, I've definitely been feeling very down.
Have you noticed a change in your energy levels or have you been feeling unusually fatigued lately, even if you're not doing much physically?

No, I... I wouldn't say I've been feeling physically tired. I mean, I know I'm not doing much right now, mostly just sitting around the apartment, but my body doesn't feel fatigued or exhausted. So, no, I haven't really noticed a change like that.
Have you been having any trouble sleeping lately, like difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up earlier than planned?

Yeah, sleep has been pretty rough. Even when I actually tried to go to bed, I'd just... I kept waking up at these weird hours. My mind would immediately snap back to this big deployment plan for work. I just couldn't shut it off. And by the time morning rolled around, I felt completely wrecked instead of rested. So, yeah, staying asleep has been a real problem.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or making decisions lately, even about small things?

No, I haven't really noticed that. I mean... I can focus fine. If anything, my mind gets completely locked onto certain things, like that deployment plan I mentioned. But as far as just general concentration or making everyday decisions... no, that hasn't been a problem for me.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, actually, my eating went completely off the rails recently. I usually track my food pretty closely, but I just... I completely stopped caring about it. For days, I wasn't eating real meals at all. I was basically just living on coffee and protein bars while I was working on that plan. I didn't even realize I was losing weight until my clothes started hanging loose on me. So, yeah, there's been a pretty big change there.
Have you found that things you usually enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends, don’t feel as rewarding or pleasurable lately?

Yeah, I have. It's actually been pretty noticeable. Normally, I have a bunch of stuff I like doing outside of work, but lately... I just haven't wanted to do any of it. I haven't gone hiking, haven't touched my photo editing stuff, and like I mentioned, I even stopped logging my meals. I also have this woodworking project sitting in my garage that I haven't even looked at. It's weird for me, because usually, those are the things that kind of keep me grounded. But right now, I just don't have any interest in them.
Have you ever had periods in the past where you felt persistently down or lost interest in things, or has this only happened in relation to your recent work stress?

No, I don't really think so. I mean... I can't think of a time where I felt like this before. Usually, I'm pretty steady, you know? I go to work, I do my hobbies, I hang out with people. This whole feeling of just... not caring about anything I usually like, it's new for me. So, yeah, I guess it's just happening right now.
Have these feelings of being down and losing interest in things been present most of the day, nearly every day, since this started?

I'm not entirely sure. I haven't really been tracking it by the hour or anything like that. I just know that lately, whenever I have downtime, the drive to do my usual stuff just isn't there. But as for it being most of the day, every single day... I don't really know. I couldn't give you an exact timeline. I just know I've been feeling pretty off.
Would you say that your low mood has been present most of the day, nearly every day, since this started, or does it come and go more randomly?

I'd say it's been pretty constant. It doesn't really come and go. Ever since the project sponsor questioned my judgment at work, it was... well, it was like the bottom just dropped out. 

Since then, it's been most of the day, every day. I just sit in my apartment feeling completely hollow, and really ashamed. I've even been crying over regular work emails that I normally would have just handled without a second thought. So, yeah, the low mood has been pretty much all the time since that happened.
